events.subject: Match membership to your visits
events.preview_text: Compare the joint membership terms, cost and benefits with the outings you have in mind.
events.body:
Compare National Trust joint membership with the visits you genuinely expect to make. It is one shared membership for two adults aged 26 or over who live at the same address.

Joint membership costs **£168 a year**, or 12 monthly payments of £14. Members receive free entry to more than 500 places in our care and free parking at most National Trust car parks.

There is no single number of visits that will suit every household. The practical test is to set those terms and benefits against the outings you have in mind.

Our membership page sets out the available options, eligibility conditions, prices and included benefits. You can use them to decide whether joint membership, or another listed option, matches your household and plans.
events.sign_off: - the National Trust customer service team

events.message: Email 1, draft 1: "Where your membership money goes"
events.subject: Where your membership money goes
events.preview_text: Consider your planned visits alongside the places your membership would help us care for.
events.body:
Every penny from National Trust membership goes towards looking after nature, beauty and history – for everyone, for ever. Your support helps us care for hundreds of places, from houses and gardens to coastlines and countryside.

National Trust joint membership is a paid membership for two adults who want to connect their visits with ongoing support for places in our care. It is worth checking the practical fit before deciding.

If you are weighing membership against paying when you visit or supporting us another way, start with the outings you genuinely expect to make. Membership should suit both your plans and the kind of commitment you want.

The membership page sets out the available options and conditions, so you can decide whether combining planned visits with ongoing support feels right for you.
